E[tp] &=& \Sigma_{i=1}^{k} P(w^i = 1 \wedge w^{k+1} = 1) \\
      &=& \Sigma_i P(w^i = 1 \wedge w^{k+1} = 1 | o=1)P(o = 1) \\
      & & + \Sigma_i P(w^i = 1 \wedge w^{k+1} = 1 | o=0)P(o = 0) \\
      &=& kppq + 0= \boxed{kp^2q} \\
E[fp] &=& P(w^{1} \ldots w^{k} = 0 \wedge w^{k+1} = 1) \\
      &=& P(o = 1 \wedge w^{1} \ldots w^{k} = 0 \wedge w^{k+1} = 1) \\
      & & + P(o = 0 \wedge w^{1} \ldots w^{k} = 0 \wedge w^{k+1} = 1) \\
      &=& q (1-p)^{k} p +0 = \boxed{q(1-p)^{k}p}
